title: Russian Green Bean and Potato Soup
description: This is a hearty Russian vegetable soup with a great flavor. Add seasonal veggies for more variety. Enjoy!
ingredients: 1 large onion, halved and thinly sliced
0.5 pound green beans, cut into 1 inch pieces
5 cups vegetable, chicken, or beef broth

steps.text: Heat vegetable oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Stir in the onion, and gently cook until softened and translucent, about 5 minutes. Add the potatoes and green beans; cook until the green beans have slightly softened, about 5 more minutes.

Pour in the vegetable stock. Bring to a boil over high heat, then lower heat to medium-low, cover, and cook until the potatoes have softened, about 15 minutes. Stir the flour into the sour cream, and add it a spoonful at a time to the simmering soup. Stir in the sauerkraut and dill, season to taste with salt and pepper. Simmer for 5 minutes more before serving.
